sql:
WITH
    (SELECT CurrencyKey FROM retail.DimCurrency WHERE CurrencyName = 'EUR' LIMIT 1) AS eur_currency_key
SELECT
    sum(
        if(
            fos.CurrencyKey = eur_currency_key,
            fos.SalesAmount,
            fos.SalesAmount * src.EndOfDayRate / eur.EndOfDayRate
        )
    ) AS online_sales_eur
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS fos
LEFT JOIN retail.FactExchangeRate AS src
    ON fos.DateKey = src.DateKey
   AND fos.CurrencyKey = src.CurrencyKey
LEFT JOIN retail.FactExchangeRate AS eur
    ON fos.DateKey = eur.DateKey
   AND eur.CurrencyKey = eur_currency_key;
